scripts.lint:workspace: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error lint:ruff lint:ty lint:type-boundaries lint:type-boundaries:tests lint:vulture format:check
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --all-packages ruff check --fix src tests && bun run format
scripts.lint:ruff: uv run --all-packages ruff check --no-fix src tests
scripts.lint:type-boundaries:tests: uv run --all-packages python -m grassmoth_checks.check_type_boundaries --select CORE001 --select CORE002 tests
scripts.format: uv run --all-packages ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check: uv run --all-packages ruff format --check src tests
